mapper.select: SELECT id, table_id, name, field_type, config, required, ai_prompt, is_ai_field, sort_order, width, created_at, updated_at FROM `bitable_fields` WHERE table_id = #{tableId} AND deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bitable_fields` WHERE table_id = #{tableId} AND deleted_at = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE `bitable_fields` SET sort_order = #{sortOrder}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at = 0
